messages:
maya: Blocking: canary promote failed. One integration axis keeps failing with artifact checksum mismatch after cache GC. Deploy-bot error: `artifact checksum mismatch`.
alex: paste runner logs?
maya: log snippet:
```text
fetching cache s3://ci-cache/shards/part-91
expected 0x7f9b got 0x2c11
error: checksum mismatch, aborting
```
sam: Sounds like a shard flip after GC. Could be upload corruption or local runner cache. Options: manual promote to last-green or requeue the failing axis on a different pool.
jen: Last green digest is sha256:abad1dea. Manual promote will skip canary changes.
maya: Proposal: targeted requeue to runner-warm (one attempt), wait 10m. If it still fails, manual promote to sha256:abad1dea and note rollback in release notes.
ci-runner-bot: requeue scheduled by @maya: `buildkite-agent build requeue --job integration/axis-5 --override-pool runner-warm`
ops-bot: Cache GC job completed ~1h ago; no S3 errors in the control plane.
maya: Requeue sent, monitoring...
ci-runner-bot: job integration/axis-5 started on runner-warm (id rw-101)
maya: job passed; artifact fetched OK, checksums matched. Proceeding with canary promote.
deploy-bot: Promotion succeeded. Canary promoted to prod. Release window remains on schedule. :tada:
